title: ui settings.jsonc
description: Runtime configuration for the ui plugin. Extend alongside the Settings struct in src/Config.hpp - missing keys fall back to their C++ defaults.

locale.description: Translation language; matches a file in configs/translations.

addonId.description: Workshop addon carrying the compiled HUD layout; 0 requires nothing of connecting clients.

toastDurationMs.description: How long a toast stays up when the caller passes 0.
